title.original: CASPIAN: Online Detection and Attribution of Cascade Attacks in LLM Multi-Agent Systems via Cross-Channel Causal Monitoring
title.zh: CASPIAN：通过跨渠道因果监控在线检测和归因LLM多智能体系统中的级联攻击
title.en: CASPIAN: Online Detection and Attribution of Cascade Attacks in LLM Multi-Agent Systems via Cross-Channel Causal Monitoring

inclusion_reason.zh: CASPIAN 提供跨通道在线因果监控、级联检测和传播路径归因，可作为多 Agent 安全观测层复用。
inclusion_reason.en: CASPIAN provides cross-channel online causal monitoring, cascade detection, and propagation attribution as a reusable multi-agent security observability layer.

abstract.zh: CASPIAN 在线建模多 Agent 跨通道的动态因果影响，用于早期检测级联攻击并归因源头、桥接和放大 Agent。
abstract.en: CASPIAN models dynamic cross-channel causal influence online to detect cascade attacks early and attribute source, bridge, and amplifier agents.

problem.zh: 级联攻击在单条文本或单个 Agent 看来可能正常，却通过多个交互通道和时间尺度传播，局部语义护栏无法识别系统级结构。
problem.en: Cascade attacks can look benign locally while spreading across interaction channels and timescales, so local semantic guardrails miss the emerging system-level structure.

approach.zh: 框架以延迟交互条件转移熵估计统一因果影响矩阵，从矩阵演化检测级联起点并重建主要传播路径。
approach.en: Late-interaction conditional transfer entropy estimates a unified causal influence matrix whose evolution signals cascade onset and reconstructs principal propagation paths.

system_design.zh: 在线监视器采集多通道事件，增量估计因果矩阵；检测器判断结构突变，归因器标记源、桥和放大节点并输出路径。
system_design.en: An online monitor ingests multichannel events and updates a causal matrix; detection identifies structural shifts, and attribution labels source, bridge, amplifier, and paths.

key_results.zh: 在多种框架和基准上，CASPIAN 比语义护栏、LLM Judge 和图异常检测更早更准地识别级联，同时延迟开销很低。
key_results.en: Across frameworks and benchmarks, CASPIAN detects cascades earlier and more accurately than semantic guardrails, LLM judges, and graph anomaly detectors at low latency overhead.

limitations.zh: 因果影响来自观测相关性与估计假设，面对刻意模拟正常通道、低频长期攻击或不可见外部通信时可能失真。
limitations.en: Causal influence relies on observational estimates and assumptions, and may degrade under normal-looking adversaries, low-rate long campaigns, or invisible external communication.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
